summary: Steakholder Foods Ltd., an Israeli food-tech company, filed a Form 6-K on August 3, 2026, disclosing a private placement with an accredited investor. The offering included pre-funded warrants to purchase 1,750,000 ADSs (each representing 12,000 ordinary shares) at $1.99 per combined unit, with series E and F warrants exercisable at $2.00 per ADS, subject to shareholder approval. Gross proceeds were approximately $3.5 million. Proceeds fund R&D and working capital. The investor is limited to 4.99% beneficial ownership, and a 60-day issuance blackout plus one-year variable-rate transaction restriction apply. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a return to shareholders.
